name: Kinzang Dorji
description: Kinzang Dorji is the Technical Lead for Bhutan's National Digital Identity (NDI), leading the engineering of the country's self-sovereign identity platform anchored on Ethereum. The work spans the full stack, from credential issuance and verification infrastructure to the citizen wallet, with a central focus on empowering digital trust: delivering secure, reliable and interoperable digital identity that puts people in control of their own data.
